name: luma-ai
description: Luma AI (Agents API): Ray 3.2 text/image to video, video edit and reframe, uni-1 images as polled jobs with downloads, credits and usage

nodes.title: Generate video
nodes.description: Text to video or image to video with Ray 3.2 (paid; waits for the generation and saves the MP4)

prompt.description: What the video should show: scene, action, camera

hdr.description: HDR video (720p/1080p, 5 s only; doubles the price)

loop.description: Seamless loop (not with 10s, hdr or an end frame)

start_frame_url.description: Public image URL for the first frame (image to video)

end_frame_url.description: Public image URL for the last frame

extend_generation_id.description: Extend this completed video generation (single-keyframe extend)

user_id.description: Your end user's stable opaque id (no personal data), for abuse attribution and usage breakdowns

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
